title: Chapter 26 Golden Armor Warrior
content:
Chapter 26 Golden Armor Warrior

To make iron arrows, he still lacked a lot of feathers.

There was no choice but to buy them.

Fortunately, there were players selling feathers.

He swept the auction house and only bought 200 units of feathers.

It cost 2.5 gold coins, mainly because some players bid a little too high. Who made him lack feathers now!

The previous feathers had been used up, and there were 21 iron ingots left, which was enough to make 2,000 arrows.

Then he silently chanted "arrowheads" in his heart.

After getting 2,000 arrowheads, he started making iron arrows again.

[10 (iron) arrows = 1 wooden stick + 10 arrowheads + 1 feather]

In less than 20 minutes, the iron arrows were made.

During this period, the wall and the toilet were also built.

He had been doing it in the house before, using pottery pots.

Now he finally had a toilet.

He hurried to experience it, but the result made Wang Shuo want to give a bad review.

Because it was a dry toilet, the smell made Wang Shuo's eyes a little irritated.

It seems that it is still necessary to upgrade the shelter as soon as possible to improve the comfort of life!

He came to the front yard again, stepped on the ground paved with earth bricks, and looked at the one-third acre of land within the wall. His mood became better.

However, there were only materials for building two arrow towers, which made him entangled.

Fortunately, the total area of his residential area was not very large, and the range of the arrow tower was 100 meters in radius.

So he built one a little bit opposite the well, almost in the center of the entire residential area, and built another one on the left side of the gate of the wall.

In this way, the firepower can not only cover the periphery of all the walls, but also focus on cleaning the area at the gate of the courtyard.

It takes 1 hour to build an arrow tower. After Wang Shuo made it, he returned to the house and planned to find a way to earn 300 gold coins from the trading house, so that he could build a golden armor warrior.

At present, bronze keys are still the best-selling.

Even if the surviving players each buy one, they can still sell more than 3,000.

But in the morning, only half of the keys Wang Shuo hung up were sold.

Either the players didn't get the bronze treasure chest, or they couldn't afford it, or they didn't know the news yet.

So Wang Shuo hurried to the [chat channel] and shouted.

"A large number of bronze keys have appeared in the trading house, which can open bronze treasure chests. In the bronze treasure chests, there are various mysterious items that can improve your survival ability! There are not many left, I won't tell ordinary people."

The efficiency of the advertisement is still considerable.

In just a few minutes, the keys in Wang Shuo's trading house were sold out in seconds.

Another 200 gold coins were in hand.

He quickly put up another 100 keys, so that the gold coins could be collected.

At this time, he found out again in the chat channel.

"What should I do if I can't afford the keys? Does anyone need a bronze treasure chest? I'll sell it."

Wang Shuo quickly searched for bronze treasure chests in the trading house, and someone really sold it.

However, the price was a bit daunting.

Most of them started at 50 gold coins.

Wang Shuo didn't want to be a sucker.

At this time, a player marked a treasure chest for 5 gold coins.

Wang Shuo bought one directly.

Opening a treasure chest is a matter of luck. If you are lucky, you can get something valuable. If you are unlucky, you will lose.

Wang Shuo went to wash his hands again. He has developed this habit now.

He opened the treasure chest and saw only one pill inside.

[Physique Enhancement Pill: After taking it, physique +3]

Seeing only one pill, Wang Shuo still felt that he had made a profit.

After all, it only cost 5 gold coins, plus a key.

After taking it, his physique directly reached 11 points. He felt that his physical fitness had made a qualitative leap, his endurance was better, and his resistance to cold was also enhanced.

Wang Shuo wanted to buy some treasure chests, but reason stopped him from buying them.

He didn't dare to gamble now. It was more important to save money to build a golden armor warrior.

There were already 970 gold coins. After a while, 30 gold coins arrived.

There were thousands of gold coins. Wang Shuo hesitated for a moment, whether to summon the peddler now.

What is needed most at present is combat power, and the golden armor warrior should be a good choice. After struggling for a while, Wang Shuo made up his mind and gave priority to making the golden armor warrior.

It takes much longer to make gold ingots than iron ingots. It took Wang Shuo almost 2 hours to make these 100 gold ingots.

500 iron ingots are needed, which means 5,000 coal and 5,000 iron ore.

He checked the iron ore in the trading house again.

The current iron ore costs about 1 silver coin per unit. In this way, he needs 50 gold coins to get all the iron ore. The price of coal is lower, about 20 gold coins.

However, there is not such a large number in the trading house, and some prices are high.

So he quickly contacted Zhang Yang and Zhao Shanhe, two players, and exchanged them for iron ore and coal with bronze keys, but the quantity was still far from enough.

Wang Shuo instantly felt that this was too difficult.

He launched an advertisement in the [Chat Channel].

It was not until 9 o'clock in the evening that all the materials were collected.

After arranging the production of iron ingots, he chose to go to sleep directly.

…

Sunset City, on the throne.

The Lord of Sunset City looked at the light curtain in front of him, and a wicked smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.

“This little guy is actually making a golden armor warrior, which is really surprising!”

He has been paying attention to these players recently, trying to find the glimmer of hope that the high priest told him.

Occasionally, there will be a few players who will make his eyes light up and remind him of his original performance.

At this time, Wang Shuo reminded him of his original regret.

“But I’m really looking forward to it!”

Before establishing a village, almost no player could obtain a unit with a single combat power reaching the Bronze Boss level.

Immediately, he contacted Lord Zach through the token given to him by Lord Zach.

"Dear Servant of God Zach, according to the rules of the game, we can issue up to 3 tasks to survivors, right?"

"certainly."

"Okay, now I want to issue a mission to Wang Shuo with ID: SAC5678." Lord Sunset stood up and said respectfully.

"Can."

…

Early the next morning.

Lord Zach's voice sounded in Wang Shuo's mind:

"Congratulations, little guy, you have gained the attention of Lord Sunset, and he decided to issue a mission to you."

"Seeing that you are still working hard, I will give you another gadget by the way."

Wang Shuo noticed at this time that there was an extra prop in his backpack.

[Identification Scroll: After use, you can identify the hidden attributes of items. 】

Wang Shuo doesn't have any items to identify now! He was a little confused.

At this time, he opened [Side Mission].

Since you have received the attention of the Sunset City Lord, the joint siege operation by the Crocodile Clan, the Demon Frog Clan, and the Silt Clan has started in advance. If you successfully survive and successfully defend the territory, the Sunset City Lord will provide you with additional rewards. Countdown 0:59.

"I'll go, it can still be like this!"

Wang Shuo was a little speechless. He felt that he was not completely ready yet.

He hurried to the workshop.

Make "Warrior in Golden Armor".

[Golden Armor Warrior: Iron Ingot 500/500, Gold Ingot 100/100, Soul 1/1]

【Whether to make it? 】

"yes."

[In production, it will take 2 hours. 】

"Two hours, the day lilies will probably be cold by then."

【Chat channel】

Wang Shuo: "Who can make the acceleration scroll? Buy it at a high price. Speed. Urgent!!!"

While sending messages, Wang Shuo took time to have breakfast.

"Boss, I want to speed up the scroll! I have 100 gold coins."

Wang Shuo looked at his backpack. Yesterday he bought iron ore at any cost, but now he only had 22 gold coins.

But the situation was urgent and I couldn’t care less.
